title: Life on the Run
text: “Father! It’s Filo-tan, indeed!”
“Motoyasu-kun, aren’t you supposed to be restraining yourself?”
“Ugh……”
Father scolded me with a smile.
“No matter what, if you pounce on her, it’s just Rafmi, nano.”
“That’s exactly what I said I wouldn’t do anymore, I say!”
“It was fun, so I prepared it! Stopping it makes things boring!”
The Filo-tans that had been bounding toward me with a boof vanished, and only after that did the real Filo-tan come strolling out from the forest. Curses, indeed!
“I could read where this was going……honestly, it was getting tiresome, so Motoyasu-kun and Rafmi-chan, behave yourselves.”
“Fools who don’t understand true entertainment……why bother taking such a farce seriously? The Spear Hero is exactly the sort who should be toyed with at times like this.”
“I am not a toy, I say!”
“I fully support harassing him, but please stop causing a ruckus here.”
Since this was Itsuki’s precious Mole’s den, Rafmi apparently felt entitled to come down hard on him. Honestly, I wished she’d just go ahead and attack him already.
“Master, there you are!”
“Right. Filo-chan, you ran here from the castle with Melty-chan and the others, didn’t you?”

“Yep! So like, Filo was with Mel-chan and everyone at the castle when we got attacked. Filo was kicking people to protect Mel-chan, but more and more people kept showing up, so Mel-chan’s dad said we should run, so we ran!”
And then……Father and the others turned their gazes to the forehead of Filo-tan in her Filolial form. There, growing from her, was a feather—the very same kind she’d received from Fitoria-tan before.
“Hm……so this is how we cross paths, is it. To think you’d meet without any of the other Heroes present. No……does that mean that king encountered her under that same count?”
“Sounds like she ran into Fitoria during their little flight, nano.”
Rafmi and Rival nodded as though they understood the situation at once.
“You can tell just from that!?”
Fiancée looked utterly astonished.
“Just what in the world……?”
Queen wore an expression of complete bewilderment.
“Mother, while I was fleeing together with Father, I had the good fortune to encounter the Filolial Queen herself!”
Guh……so Fiancée and the others had already met Fitoria-tan. How infuriating.
“And then it turned into a discussion about sparring with Filo-chan……and after a truly splendid match, I was given this feather.”
“I see. And what did Aultcray say?”
“He was astonished. He even said he wished you could have been there to witness it yourself, Mother.”
“Yes, frankly, I find myself quite envious of such an encounter. I too would have liked to meet the legendary Filolial.”
Queen was apparently something of a legend enthusiast. Whenever the subject of Fitoria-tan came up, she always seemed rather pleased.
“Even if she did meet her, it’s not really something worth getting that excited over, nano. Fitoria’s actually pretty carefree and dim-witted, nano.”
“Indeed. In the end, she’s nothing more than the ringleader of the Filolials.”
“Don’t you dare speak ill of Fitoria-tan, I say!”
“The facts don’t change. Though it would be far more amusing to arrange a meeting between her and the Spear Hero, wouldn’t it?”
“That sounds like it’d only end in disaster.”
“Fu……isn’t that precisely what makes it entertaining?”
“Rafmi, do you do anything besides stir up trouble!?”
Ren was grumbling. But I love Fitoria-tan too, I say!

“Let’s save the nonsense for later—could someone take us to meet the runaway king already? There’s a great deal to sort out afterward, and he needs to pay the price for causing all this ridiculous trouble.”
Itsuki, still riding atop Father, pressed everyone to hurry things along.
“Meeting Fitoria-tan was no nonsense, I say!”
“Be that as it may. Frankly, from where I stand, it doesn’t matter one way or the other. Please let Naofumi-san and the rest handle that side of things.”
“And what is that supposed to mean, hm? Looking for a fight, are we?”
“Naofumi-san. If we keep going in circles, I’ll just go ahead and act on my own—is that alright with you?”
“Well……I suppose that particular matter should wait for another day. Alright then, Filo, Melty-chan……would you take us to see that king? I’m a little worried about the kids we left in your care too.”
“Sure. This way. The Shadows loyal to Father and Mother’s faction have set up traps around here, so we’ll need to be careful not to trip them.”

Acting as the one directing the operation, Father gave the order to Fiancée and the others. It seemed there were pigs claiming to be Shadows lurking about the area as well—the sort that would appear the moment you called for them. Together with Queen and the rest, we made our way into Mole’s den. There, sitting like a gatekeeper on a chair inside one of the rooms, watching over any visitors, was Tiger Guy.
“Visitors, huh……given the look of things, no……it’s you lot.”
“Ah, been a while. How’ve you been holding up?”
“You dragged Atla off without so much as asking, made me live with some incomprehensible fellow, and before I even knew what was happening, I was forced into a life on the run!”
What is wrong with you people! Tiger Guy protested to Father.
“Just bear with it a little longer. We just need……to have a word with the king.”
“Fine. I’ll take Atla with me, so you lot can go ahead and talk amongst yourselves.”
With that answer, Tiger Guy stepped through the door he’d been guarding, exchanged a few words with someone inside, then led Tiger Girl out by the hand. So Trash was inside this room.
“So, who’s going in first, I wonder?”
“Wouldn’t it make the most sense for his own wife, Queen, to be the one to call out to him?”
Queen glanced at Tiger Girl, narrowing her eyes as she hid her mouth behind her fan, nodding as though something had clicked into place.

“I’d heard reports, but……I see. Very well, I shall go in first. Under ordinary circumstances I would have lectured him thoroughly before dispensing punishment, but given the circumstances, circumstances being what they are……”

Muttering under her breath, Queen knocked on the door and stepped inside, and the rest of us followed. Within the room, Trash stood waiting, clothes tattered here and there, eyes burning with displeasure. Trash turned his gaze toward Queen first, looking away awkwardly out of guilt, before spotting Father and raising one eyebrow in obvious irritation.
“So this is where you’ve been hiding. And how does it feel, I wonder? Being chased down by the very filth of our own nation—filth that should have been serving under you as subordinates……”
Seizing the moment, Queen hurled cold words at Trash.
“Those wretches had the audacity to target that child’s own children! That is one thing that cannot be forgiven, even from allies!”
“And the result of that is the present state of affairs, is it not? Honestly……to think you’d be so thoroughly exploited by the state religion that they’d even seize the castle from you.”

Even Trash, faced with Queen’s words, seemed to have no excuse to offer. It was strange to see him so subdued—usually whenever something went wrong, it was Father who got blamed for everything as a matter of course.
“I suppose we should count it a small mercy that you haven’t declared the entire fault lies with Iwatani-sama, the Shield Hero.”
“Hmph! Shield! How dare you bring that child to such a place! Because of that, I’ve been reduced to this sorry state! Are you pleased with yourself, you devil!”
Trash jabbed a finger at Father, spitting out his grievances.
“Hah……honestly.”

Father scratched his head with a sigh mixed in. Well, it had been Rafmi who’d taken the initiative to bring Tiger Girl along—Father hadn’t been the one to order it. Still, since Rafmi had entrusted Tiger Girl to Trash under the pretense of it being Father’s good will, one could say Father bore some responsibility for how things had turned out after all.

“I’ll take all the abuse you want to throw at me. If you say I’m treating human lives lightly, I won’t argue back. Well……considering the humiliation you put me through, I suppose this counts as me getting a bit of my own back.”
Father matched the mood, firing back at Trash.
“What did you say!”
“I made sure to assign proper guards so there wouldn’t be any problems, didn’t I? And the proof is that you all managed to escape safely thanks to them, isn’t it?”

This was about how Filo-tan had been assigned to guard Fiancée and the others. It seemed Filo-tan had been thoroughly strengthened, so running circles around their pursuers had been child’s play for her.
“Aultcray, surely you understand this isn’t the time to be squabbling. I understand there are old grudges between you, but please, prioritize overcoming this crisis first.”
“Guh……”

“Heroes, thank you for arranging this meeting with Aultcray. If you could see fit to return us to our army’s location once more, the rest will be our nation’s problem to handle. We will see to eliminating those occupying the castle ourselves, so please continue your work for the sake of the world.”
In short, it seemed Queen was asking, out of consideration, that we leave the matter of the Three Heroes Church’s lot to them.
